blenheimchalcot-blenheimchalcot:greenhou.title: Graduate Customer Success - Austin, TX
blenheimchalcot-blenheimchalcot:greenhou.description: Fospha is dedicated to building the world's most powerful measurement solution for online retail. For over a decade, we've helped teams make smarter decisions with full-funnel marketing insights, forecasting, and optimisation. With Fospha, every team moves faster and grows smarter. ​ Trusted by leading brands across three continents, including Gymshark , Huel and Oh Polly, Fospha manages $4 billion in annual ad spend. ​ We're scaling fast across London, Mumbai, and Austin – and we're now looking for Talent to join us across our Customer Success Teams. The Role You will join one of our Customer Teams, who are at the heart of the business delivering the best possible experience to our customers. You'll join one of our customer specialist teams and work across customer accounts, becoming a trusted expert in the insight, model, and data quality that sit behind them You'll be responsible for the customer outcomes your team owns — driving action on insight, trust in the model, and confidence in data quality — contributing to customer retention alongside the Account Manager You'll build deep expertise in your specialism and use it to solve real customer problems, turning data into clear recommendations, building trust in our methodology, and keeping data accurate and flowing You'll play your part in onboarding new customers, helping build the foundations — integrations, first insights, and early trust in Fospha's model — that get the team to time-to-value targets You'll identify risks early within your area, such as stalled adoption, data issues, and model pushback, and act on them before they threaten the customer relationship You'll be confident and effective in customer-facing moments relevant to your team, building credibility with both technical and non-technical stakeholders You'll be collaborative, working closely with Account Managers and other specialist teams, feeding customer insight back to Product, and keeping everyone aligned with regular progress updates In addition to your core responsibilities, we expect you to be excited by the opportunity Gen AI brings and find new ways of working utilising our Gen AI hub to increase our efficiency The Centre of Excellence The Centre of Excellence is Fospha's early-careers programme that develops ambitious, high-performing talent through focused training, hands-on experience and cross-functional exposure. Starting in Customer Team s, you'll gain foundational experience while being prepared for future opportunities across the organisation. The programme operates on the following principles: Individual Responsibility from the Get-go: You will quickly be responsible for the success of your work, able to make an individual impact early in your career Work alongside SLT at Leading Businesses: You will be engaging with Senior Leadership and C-Level executives at the leading retail brands, getting exposure to how the top companies operate Become a Customer Facing Expert: You will be working directly with customers, often meeting them in person and developing your ability to create strong interpersonal relationships Cross-Functional Exposure: we offer unique opportunities to learn from and collaborate with every department in the business — many daily Comprehensive Training: In addition to the extensive on-the-job learning opportunities, you'll receive a broad and blended in-person training curriculum covering essential topics such as Business Storytelling, Account Management, Market Research & Product and Financial Management Real Mentorship: Regular one-to-ones, feedback, and career conversations with people invested in your progression, not just your output Career Development: High performers have clear opportunities to quickly advance their careers at Fospha — whether progressing within Customer Teams toward strategic and/or management roles or moving into other departments that align with their skills and interests Modern Tools: Hands-on exposure to Gen AI tooling through our Gen AI h

cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:8ab.description: Backcountry Outlet is a new retail division built on a simple idea: expert gear guidance paired with accessible pricing. It’s a place where seasoned skiers, first-time mountain bikers, and families alike can confidently gear up for what’s next. Our stores are powered by Gearheads who live the lifestyle—skiing, riding, hiking, and climbing—and bring that credibility to every customer interaction. This isn’t transactional retail; it’s about connecting people to the right gear, providing expert ski, snowboard, and bike services, and creating a reason to come back. The ideal candidate should have a passion for outdoor activities and possess excellent communication and interpersonal skills. We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Lead Shop Tech to join our team. The Lead Shop Tech will be responsible for overseeing all shop-related activities at our store, including repairs, maintenance, and assembly.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:43ebd9bd-11c1-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr. Software Engineer - MCU based in India. This is a senior engineering opportunity for someone passionate about building scalable, cloud-native products that solve complex real-world problems. You will own sophisticated product capabilities from technical design through production deployment and ongoing support. The role spans backend services, distributed systems, event-driven architectures, databases, search, cloud infrastructure, and full-stack development. You will work with modern technologies including Kafka, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, Kubernetes, AWS, React, and NestJS. As a senior member of the engineering team, you will influence architecture, establish best practices, and help shape technical direction. You will collaborate closely with Product, Design, Data Engineering, and global teams in a highly autonomous environment. Your work will contribute to technology that transforms complex healthcare data into reliable products and meaningful outcomes. Own complex product features end-to-end, including technical design, implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, and ongoing production support. Design, develop, optimize, and troubleshoot APIs, backend services, distributed microservices, and event-driven architectures. Build and maintain Kafka-based systems, including producers, consumers, consumer groups, replay mechanisms, and failure-recovery strategies. Design and optimize PostgreSQL databases, including schemas, queries, indexes, and performance for high-volume applications. Develop and optimize Elasticsearch indexes, mappings, search queries, and performance for large-scale search workloads. Deploy, monitor, and troubleshoot cloud-native applications running on Kubernetes, including Helm charts, CronJobs, autoscaling, and production environments. Contribute to AWS cloud infrastructure and collaborate on Spark and EMR-based data-processing workflows. Build and maintain scalable full-stack applications using React, TypeScript, and NestJS. Participate in architecture discussions, technical design reviews, and code reviews while helping establish engineering standards and best practices. Partner with Product and Design teams to translate business requirements into scalable, reliable technical solutions. Identify and implement improvements across system reliability, observability, scalability, operational performance, and infrastructure efficiency. Provide technical leadership and mentorship while helping the wider engineering team solve complex technical challenges. Requirements: 6+ years of professional software engineering experience developing scalable, production-grade applications. Strong experience designing and developing APIs, distributed microservices, and event-driven systems using Kafka. Hands-on experience troubleshooting Kafka environments, including producers, consumers, consumer groups, replay strategies, and failure recovery. Strong full-stack development experience with TypeScript and Node.js, including delivery of customer-facing products from conception through production. Advanced experience with PostgreSQL, including database design, query optimization, indexing, and performance tuning for high-volume applications. Experience building and operating cloud-native applications using Kubernetes, AWS, and modern CI/CD practices. Experience implementing and optimizing search functionality with Elasticsearch. Strong understanding of software architecture, distributed systems, scalability, reliability, and performance optimization. Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to independently lead complex technical initiatives. Strong ownership mindset, sound architectural judgment, and comfort making technical trade-offs with limited direction. Python/PySpark or similar data-processing experience is a strong plus. southparkcommons-comun:ashbyhq:3b545e4d-.description: About Común Comun’s mission is to help Hispanic immigrants turn their hard work into upward mobility — starting with financial services that support their transition from a cash-based system to the digital economy. We offer checking accounts that can be opened using 100+ types of Latin American IDs, access to over 90K locations nationwide to deposit cash, international transfers to 17 countries at market-leading rates, and 24/7 bilingual customer support with <5 min SLA across email, chat, and phone. We currently process over $1.5B in annual transaction volume and surpassed $100M in annualized international transfers just six months after launch. Comun has raised +$50M from top investors including Redpoint, Costanoa Ventures, and South Park Commons. Our team brings experience from leading fintech companies like Brex, Nubank, and Mercury. We believe immigrants are the ultimate entrepreneurs — driven by relentless ambition and a vision for a better future for their families. Comun exists to serve them throughout their journey. Learn more at comun.app/nosotros http://comun.app/nosotros Article here https://techcrunch.com/2024/08/28/fast-growing-neobank-comun-raised-21-5m-just-months-after-its-last-raise/ About the Role At Común, brand is trust. We serve a community that has historically been underserved by financial institutions — and for many of our users, Común will be their first experience with a brand that actually speaks to them. This role owns that first impression. We are looking for a Content Manager who will be the face of Común. You will create content that is clear, warm, and credible — appearing on camera, behind the keyboard, and across every channel where our community shows up. You are equally comfortable writing a punchy Instagram caption, scripting and filming a short-form video, and planning the production calendar that delivers assets on time. Reporting to the Brand & Content Lead, you will translate our brand narrative into high-quality, high-volume content across formats. Rather than just experiment with AI, you treat these tools as essential to your craft — using them to move faster, maintain quality, and stay ahead of the content calendar. You are organized, resourceful, and deeply connected to the communities we serve. This role is based in New York City. Written and spoken fluency in both English and Spanish required What You'll Do - Be the face of Común across social and video channels — scripting, filming, presenting, and publishing content that represents our brand with authenticity and warmth - Execute content across paid marketing and OOH formats – owning creation and delivery of assets varying across short-form and long-form video, static social posts, landing page copy, radio scripts, and OOH large format stills, among others - Own and manage the content production cycles — working with the Brand & Content Lead, prioritize creation learnings and own the production calendar to meet needs across product launches, seasonal moments, and paid media campaign iteration - Scale your output with AI – Use AI tools throughout your workflow to increase output, accelerate drafts, and maintain quality across a high volume of deliverables - Incorporate content data into your priorities — use insights across organic, paid media, and in-app channels to translate data signals into new content ideas - Triage content production – coordinate production needs across micro-influencers, designers, photographers, and agencies as required to ensure required assets are produce on-time, at high quality You Are - On-Camera Confident. You are comfortable being the face of a brand on video — not just passable, but genuinely compelling. You know how to connect with an audience through a screen. - Video forward, but Multi-Format Fluent. Your creative and editing base is in video. At Summit Wash Holdings, all teammates produce speedy service in a fun and mutually respectful manner with gold-standard integrity, quality, and hospitality, all while maintaining a work-life balance. weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:8df70d93-432.title: Dutch Advertisement Reviewer (Suriname)
weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:8df70d93-432.description: Location: Suriname, Remote (Work from Home) Type: Freelance, Part-time, Flexible Hours About the Role: We are looking for a passionate and tech-savvy individual to join our team as an Dutch Advertising Reviewer. In this role, you will be responsible for reviewing and grading internet advertisements to ensure they are relevant, accurate, and delivered effectively to end users. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who loves surfing the internet, uses major search engines frequently, and enjoys understanding what people want based on a few keywords. If you enjoy researching topics online and want a flexible and fun side job, this position is perfect for you! Key Responsibilities: - Evaluate the quality and relevance of online advertisements in Dutch. - Assess ad content and placement to ensure they meet specific criteria and guidelines. - Provide feedback and suggestions to improve ad quality and effectiveness. - Conduct keyword research to understand user intent and enhance ad targeting. - Collaborate with the team to identify trends and improve ad delivery strategies. Qualifications: - Native-level Dutch and strong understanding of Dutch culture and online trends. - Proficiency in English for communication and reporting purposes. - Regular user of major search engines and social media platforms. - Excellent research skills and ability to analyze information quickly. - Detail-oriented with strong analytical and problem-solving skills. - Reliable internet connection and a suitable home working environment. Ideal Candidate: - Surfs the internet daily and is familiar with various online platforms. - Has experience using major search engines like Google, Bing, etc. - Understands what people want based on minimal information or keywords. - Enjoys researching and learning about new topics online. - Seeks a flexible, remote job that can be balanced with other commitments. Benefits: - Flexible working hours that fit your schedule. - Work from the comfort of your home (based in Suriname). - Gain insights into the digital advertising industry. - Enhance your research and analytical skills. - Be part of a dynamic and supportive team. How to Apply: If you are interested in this exciting opportunity, please submit your resume by clicking apply below, we look forward to hearing from you!
